title: Why We Call It a Breakthrough
short_teaser: Breakthrough suggests passing through a barrier that had blocked progress.
story: Breakthrough suggests passing through a barrier that had blocked progress. The word makes insight sound sudden, even when the real process was long. Language often highlights the visible moment and hides the years that prepared it. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
